sections.description: Mimam's Var - WP is a modular design-system operating layer inside WordPress. Centralize your CSS variables, manage theme scales, configure fluid scales, build layout utility structures, and sync seamlessly with Figma.
sections.changelog:
v1.3.130 - Dev

  • Improved Bulk Targeting Accuracy: Hardened bulk selection logic by combining results from both Bricks data and canvas DOM. Mixed elements (e.g. Basic Text set to custom tag li vs native list items) are correctly unioned.

v1.3.129 - Dev

  • Added Skip Preview Setting: Added a Mimam’s Bar setting to skip bulk preview confirmation.
  • Fixed Combined Selector Matching: Fixed matching for commands like all li.bulk-lab__item => data-anim="fade-up".

v1.3.120 - Dev

  • Hardened Deep Equality Checks: Fixed out of memory crashes caused by recursive object key traversal on complex Vue reactive proxies and DOM nodes/settings. Introduced a safe JSON stringify comparison with recursive key sorting that ignores undefined key properties, eliminating reactivity sync loops.
